scope: Host headset microphone: Headset microphone card (host/microphone_setup.py); on request downloads VB-CABLE Pack45 from VB-Audio, extracts to a new folder, holds the files open (Windows CreateFileW with read-only sharing, reparse points and hard links refused), verifies them through the handles (unchanged since download, no other file in the folder, pinned package SHA-256 or for a newer package an Authenticode signature with subject exactly CN=BUREL VINCENT Entrepreneur individuel, SERIALNUMBER=423 734 177), re-checks the folder, opens VB-Audio's setup through the runas verb (never silently: its licence forbids building it into another installation) and deletes the files; states ready / restart / disabled / missing / error; a page check never replaces a running setup; a still-open setup window is never opened twice; session warnings name the missing step

Game Mode headset recognition by EDID head-mounted markers (Microsoft HMD VSDB, DisplayID 2.0 HMD primary use) and the kernel non-desktop property (lease helper --list-connectors, which drops DRM master at once; read only for displays the EDID does not settle, refreshed in the background), in launcher/game_mode.py and core/headset_edid.hpp; the wrapper records each start (gamescope-wrapper.json) and falls back to plain gamescope with the original library path

Game Mode screen: every desktop setting on scrolling pages, focused-row explanations, B/Escape go back and never exit, Start explains why it cannot start, Wi-Fi 7 bands; a second Start during a session is refused

Headset-PC graphics limit (launcher/graphics_limit.py): 8 of 30 streaming seconds at SteamVR's reduced rate, counted after 5 s of video while frames arrive at the refresh and the headset is tracked; in-headset line once per session, page advice with the headset's smaller size (Standard on a Beyond, High on an Index), reprojection repair; re-aim pause only on the two-pass path; Auto starts the Beyond at Standard

Fused frame pass (client/platform/linux/fused.comp): decoded NV12/P010 planes copied into owned images at decode time (timeline semaphores, layouts tracked); one compute pass per shown frame: re-aim homography, ALVR foveation inverse, 9-tap Catmull-Rom luma, contrast-adaptive sharpening (CAS amount rule, faded out in reduced foveation edges), chroma bilinear at its siting, colour conversion, dither, 2-pixel fade; 208-byte push constants (RADV and lavapipe allow 256), fallback to convert.comp + reaim.comp (also with the troubleshooting setting One-pass frame path off, native --two-pass, without sharpening); TIMING frame_pass, fused_frames, fused_skipped, sharpening; under a 0.37 degree re-aim a detailed scene differs from the original by 0.724 levels against 2.212 for RC4.2's two passes
Sharpening setting Off/Low/Medium/High = 0/35/70/120 % (--sharpening N, stdin sharpen N), default Medium, applied at once

Eye-tracked foveation tuning: sharp region Small/Medium/Large = 30/40/55 % of each eye, outside More detail/Balanced/Lightest = 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 resolution (eye-tracked preset only; values within what RC4.2 hosts accept)

Live eye view: native FOVEA lines at 10 Hz (client/device/fovea_view.hpp, gaze shown only when under 100 ms old), kept in memory only (launcher/fovea.py; never logged, journaled or reported), local /fovea for the pages, client to host /fovea session-link request (feature fovea-view, lease owner only, rate limited), panels on both pages and the Game Mode eyes page; host reports and the event journal drop the driver's foveation centres
Stream recovery: a session starts with no downtime, video counts while decoded frames advance, the host counts downtime only within the session
Wi-Fi 7 multi-link summary lists every band; the 2.4 GHz warning needs every link on 2.4 GHz
